name: Doki Doki Just Us
summary: After the school festival two new members joined the literature club. One is shy and the other is playful on the outside, but what are they truly like? Will they get along well with the other girls? Will our protagonist find true love during all the calamity? Find out now!But remember... this mod adapts to the choices you make. Choose Wisley...
